# NEW 2026-11-22 v13.0 Worker 2 (Slot 97 oe_afr_): Africa Three Independent Civilization Axes — Solomonic Ethiopia, Mali/Songhai Timbuktu & Kilwa/Swahili/Zimbabwe (0 new rules, 0 vanilla overrides). Generated by gen_v130_africa.py; edit the generator, not this file.

# Slot 97 entry: scheduler host scope, months 1/4/7/10 (staggered with Slot 98 2/5/8/11).
# Idempotent per calendar month via global_var:oe_afr_ran_m.
oe_afr_monthly = {
	set_global_variable = { name = oe_afr_ran_m value = oe_ml_month_now }
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_afr_init } }
		set_global_variable = { name = oe_afr_init value = 1 }
		set_global_variable = { name = oe_afr_pulse_count value = 0 }
	}
	change_global_variable = { name = oe_afr_pulse_count add = 1 }
	# Autonomous historical world progression when Rule #17 allows AI participation.
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { oe_rule_is_global_arcs_player_only = yes } }
		if = {
			limit = {
				current_year >= 1460
				NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_afr_prester_john_pact }
				country_exists = c:ETH
				oe_afr_has_prester_john_partner = yes
			}
			set_global_variable = { name = oe_afr_prester_john_pact value = 1 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				current_year >= 1500
				NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_afr_sankore_golden_age }
				OR = {
					country_exists = c:SON
					country_exists = c:MAL
				}
			}
			set_global_variable = { name = oe_afr_sankore_golden_age value = 1 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				current_year >= 1510
				has_global_variable = oe_weu2_por_cartaz_active
				NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_afr_swahili_monsoon_league }
				OR = {
					country_exists = c:ZAN
					country_exists = c:ZMW
					country_exists = c:MBA
				}
			}
			set_global_variable = { name = oe_afr_swahili_monsoon_league value = 1 }
		}
	}
}

# Country scope: protagonist quarterly check (months 1/4/7/10 via on_action/oe_afr_pulse.txt).
oe_afr_country_tick = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			is_ai = yes
			oe_rule_is_global_arcs_full_ai = yes
			NOT = { has_variable = oe_afr_ai_cd }
		}
		set_variable = { name = oe_afr_ai_cd years = 10 }
		add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_afr_rival_ai_mod years = 10 mode = replace }
	}
	# Cross-module passive synergy: v12.5 Saharan Scholar Caravan + Sankore Golden Age.
	if = {
		limit = {
			oe_afr_is_sahel_axis = yes
			has_variable = oe_nav2_done_sahara
			NOT = { has_variable = oe_afr_sahara_syn_cd }
		}
		set_variable = { name = oe_afr_sahara_syn_cd years = 15 }
		add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_afr_sahara_caravan_synergy_mod years = 15 mode = replace }
	}
	# Cross-module passive synergy: v10.0 Chalcedon Accord + Prester John Pact.
	if = {
		limit = {
			oe_afr_is_ethiopia_axis = yes
			has_global_variable = oe_afr_prester_john_pact
			oe_afr_has_chalcedon_accord = yes
			NOT = { has_variable = oe_afr_chalcedon_syn_cd }
		}
		set_variable = { name = oe_afr_chalcedon_syn_cd years = 20 }
		add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_afr_chalcedon_holy_league_mod years = 20 mode = replace }
	}
	# Cross-module passive synergy: v11.5 Diu Coalition + Swahili Anti-Cartaz League.
	if = {
		limit = {
			oe_afr_is_swahili_axis = yes
			has_global_variable = oe_afr_swahili_monsoon_league
			has_global_variable = oe_ind_diu_coalition_active
			NOT = { has_variable = oe_afr_diu_syn_cd }
		}
		set_variable = { name = oe_afr_diu_syn_cd years = 15 }
		add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_afr_diu_kilwa_naval_pact_mod years = 15 mode = replace }
	}
	oe_afr_story_tick = yes
}

# Country scope: fires at most one eligible historical story event per quarterly tick.
oe_afr_story_tick = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_variable = oe_afr_ev1_done }
			oe_afr_is_ethiopia_axis = yes
			current_year >= 1440
			current_year <= 1485
			OR = {
				owns = location:ankober
				owns = location:debre_libanos
				owns = location:lalibela
			}
		}
		set_variable = { name = oe_afr_ev1_done value = 1 }
		trigger_event_non_silently = oe_afr.1
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_variable = oe_afr_ev2_done }
			oe_afr_is_ethiopia_axis = yes

	else_if = {

# Shared country-scope milestone helper: 1450 Council of Debre Mitmaq & Mashafa Berhan.
oe_afr_apply_mitmaq_concord = {
	add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_afr_mashafa_berhan_mod years = 25 mode = replace }
	add_stability = 8
	add_religious_influence = 30
	if = {
		limit = {
			exists = religion
			religion = religion:miaphysite
		}
		set_religious_school = religious_school:oe_afr_school_ewostathian_tewahedo
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_afr_mashafa_art_done } }
		set_variable = { name = oe_afr_mashafa_art_done value = 1 }
		if = {
			limit = { owns = location:debre_libanos }
			location:debre_libanos = {
				create_art = {
					type = work_of_art_type:treatise
					quality = 85
					key = oe_afr_art_mashafa_berhan
				}
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { owns = location:ankober }
			location:ankober = {
				create_art = {
					type = work_of_art_type:treatise
					quality = 85
					key = oe_afr_art_mashafa_berhan
				}
			}
		}
		else = {
			capital ?= {
				create_art = {
					type = work_of_art_type:treatise
					quality = 85
					key = oe_afr_art_mashafa_berhan
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

# Shared country-scope milestone helper: Prester John Red Sea Pact (cross-worker contract + Chalcedon synergy).
oe_afr_enact_prester_john_pact = {
	set_global_variable = { name = oe_afr_prester_john_pact value = 1 }
	if = {
		limit = { oe_afr_has_chalcedon_accord = yes }
		add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_afr_chalcedon_holy_league_mod years = 30 mode = replace }
		add_research_progress = research_progress_severe_bonus
		add_prestige = 20
	}
	else = {
		add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_afr_prester_john_accord_mod years = 25 mode = replace }
		add_research_progress = research_progress_mild_bonus
		add_prestige = 12
	}
}

# Shared country-scope milestone helper: Askia Sankore Charter (cross-worker contract + Sahara caravan synergy).
oe_afr_enact_sankore_charter = {
	set_global_variable = { name = oe_afr_sankore_golden_age value = 1 }
	add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_afr_sankore_golden_age_mod years = 25 mode = replace }
	add_prestige = 15
	if = {
		limit = {
			exists = religion
			religion = religion:sunni
		}
		set_religious_school = religious_school:oe_afr_school_timbuktu_maliki
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_afr_sankore_art_done } }
		set_variable = { name = oe_afr_sankore_art_done value = 1 }
		if = {
			limit = { owns = location:timbuktu }
			location:timbuktu = {
				create_art = {
					type = work_of_art_type:treatise
					quality = 88
					key = oe_afr_art_timbuktu_chronicles
				}
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { owns = location:gao }
			location:gao = {
				create_art = {
					type = work_of_art_type:treatise
					quality = 88
					key = oe_afr_art_timbuktu_chronicles
				}
			}
		}
		else = {
			capital ?= {
				create_art = {
					type = work_of_art_type:treatise
					quality = 88
					key = oe_afr_art_timbuktu_chronicles
				}
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = oe_nav2_done_sahara }
		add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_afr_sahara_caravan_synergy_mod years = 25 mode = replace }
		add_research_progress = research_progress_severe_bonus
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_afr_sahara_zij_done } }
			set_variable = { name = oe_afr_sahara_zij_done value = 1 }
			capital ?= {
				create_art = {
					type = work_of_art_type:treatise
					quality = 86
					key = oe_afr_art_saharan_astronomy_zij
				}
			}
		}
	}
	else = {
		add_research_progress = research_progress_mild_bonus
	}
}

# Shared country-scope milestone helper: 1591 Tondibi Arquebus Reform (cross-worker contract).
oe_afr_enact_tondibi_reform = {
	set_global_variable = { name = oe_afr_tondibi_survived value = 1 }
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_afr_tondibi_shock_mod }
		remove_country_modifier = oe_afr_tondibi_shock_mod
	}
	add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_afr_tondibi_arquebus_corps_mod years = 30 mode = replace }
	add_army_tradition = 15
	add_research_progress = research_progress_mild_bonus
}

# Shared country-scope helper: strictly 6-point guarded CB grant against European intruders in Swahili coast.
oe_afr_grant_monsoon_cb_against_intruders = {
	every_country = {
		limit = {
			oe_afr_european_in_swahili = yes
		}
		save_scope_as = oe_afr_cb_tgt
		root = {
			if = {
				limit = {
			country_exists = scope:oe_afr_cb_tgt
			NOT = { this = scope:oe_afr_cb_tgt }
			NOT = { is_subject_of = scope:oe_afr_cb_tgt }
			NOT = { is_at_war_with = scope:oe_afr_cb_tgt }
			NOT = { has_truce_with = scope:oe_afr_cb_tgt }
			NOT = { is_allied_with = { target = scope:oe_afr_cb_tgt } }
				}
				add_casus_belli = {
					target = scope:oe_afr_cb_tgt
					type = casus_belli:oe_afr_cb_swahili_monsoon_liberation
					years = 10
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

# Shared country-scope milestone helper: Swahili Anti-Cartaz Monsoon League (cross-worker contract + Diu synergy).
oe_afr_enact_swahili_league = {
	set_global_variable = { name = oe_afr_swahili_monsoon_league value = 1 }
	add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_afr_swahili_monsoon_league_mod years = 25 mode = replace }
	add_navy_tradition = 15
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = oe_ind_diu_coalition_active }
		add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_afr_diu_kilwa_naval_pact_mod years = 25 mode = replace }
		add_prestige = 15
	}
	oe_afr_grant_monsoon_cb_against_intruders = yes
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------------ Stage Page 89 Dev helpers (8 buttons)
oe_afr_dev_unlock_all = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_advance = oe_afr_adv_mashafa_berhan_canon } }
		research_advance = advance_type:oe_afr_adv_mashafa_berhan_canon
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_advance = oe_afr_adv_prester_john_matchlocks } }
		research_advance = advance_type:oe_afr_adv_prester_john_matchlocks
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_advance = oe_afr_adv_sankore_manuscript_guilds } }
		research_advance = advance_type:oe_afr_adv_sankore_manuscript_guilds
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_advance = oe_afr_adv_tondibi_gunpowder_reform } }
		research_advance = advance_type:oe_afr_adv_tondibi_gunpowder_reform
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_advance = oe_afr_adv_al_mawahib_gold_monsoon } }
		research_advance = advance_type:oe_afr_adv_al_mawahib_gold_monsoon
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_advance = oe_afr_adv_counter_cartaz_dhows } }
		research_advance = advance_type:oe_afr_adv_counter_cartaz_dhows
	}
}
